The Problem

Most hearing practices fight
the same three battles.

01 / Patients

They don't understand.

Patients don't fully grasp hearing loss or their options — so they leave uncertain, delay the decision, and often never come back.

02 / Staff

They're worn out.

Your team spends hours repeating the same explanations, visit after visit. That's time that should go to patient care, not patient convincing.

03 / Owners

Revenue walks out the door.

Every patient who leaves unsure is lost revenue — not because of clinical quality, but because of a trust and education gap.

The Hearing Story System™
closes all three.

One integrated system for patient trust, education, and follow-up.

The Hearing Story System™

Questions before
you invest.

Everything you need to make a confident decision.

A videographer captures footage. We build a patient education system. The difference is strategy, psychology, and distribution. Our content is scripted using patient psychology frameworks designed to address the specific hesitations and objections hearing healthcare patients experience — then deployed across every platform where your future patients are searching for answers. A videographer hands you a file. We hand you a patient acquisition asset.
We build a digital version of you — or a professional on-screen clinician — from a single short recording session. The clone can then produce new education videos on any hearing health topic you approve, in your voice, with your branding, at a fraction of the time and cost of traditional video production. You approve every script before production begins. The result is consistent, clinically accurate patient education content that sounds and feels like it came directly from your practice.
Completely. Before production begins, we conduct a full branding intake covering your colors, logo, tone of voice, and the specific patient demographics you serve. Every asset is built to look, sound, and feel like a natural extension of your practice — not generic content that could belong to any clinic in the country.
For Foundation: approximately 45 minutes for a branding intake call and one short recording session. For Growth and Authority packages: roughly 30 minutes per month for script review and approval. Everything else — production, editing, formatting, distribution setup, optimization — is handled entirely by our team. Most of our clients tell us the system runs so smoothly they sometimes forget it's running.
Yes. Every package is designed to build on the one before it. Many practices start with Foundation to see the immediate impact of professional patient education on their inquiry rate — then upgrade to Growth or Authority once they're ready to scale. When you upgrade, we incorporate everything already built for your practice, so nothing is wasted.
We are the only patient education and content system built by someone who has personally experienced hearing loss. Our founder, Korey Bogle, is hearing impaired — which means every script, every video, and every piece of content we produce is informed by a deep, lived understanding of what hearing healthcare patients actually feel, fear, and need to hear before they say yes. That perspective cannot be replicated by a general marketing agency, and it is the reason our content converts at a fundamentally different level.

Not sure which package fits your practice? Book a free 15-minute assessment — we'll review your current situation and tell you exactly which tier makes sense for where you are today.

Korey Bogle — Founder, QSP AI Consulting

My story. My mission.
I know this struggle —
because I live it.

I'm hearing impaired.

I know what it's like to miss parts of conversations. To smile and nod because you didn't catch what was said. To feel frustrated, isolated, and left out of moments that matter.

I know what hearing loss does to relationships. The embarrassment. The misunderstandings. The exhaustion of constantly trying to keep up. Because I've lived all of it.

That's why I built QSP AI Consulting — not to be another marketing agency, but to help hearing care providers connect with patients on a deeper level. To help practices communicate the emotional transformation behind better hearing.

Because hearing aids aren't really about technology. They're about reconnecting with your spouse. Hearing your grandchildren laugh. Feeling confident again. Being part of the conversation.

The truth is simple: I understand your patients because I am one. And everything we create is designed to help more people hear better, live better, and reconnect with what matters most.
